text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
It might be about time to wrap things up—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san, ya still going for more laps?
Didn't ya just take first place by a mile in the mock race?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why I'll aim even higher.
I don't even want to lose to my past self.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Besides...
You're going to keep running too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, ya saw right through me, didn't ya?
Well then, since ya see right through me, mind if I ask ya to be my running partner?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, after all...
would it be alright if I ran a little more?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Those two are so skilled, yet
they continue to hone themselves, striving for even greater heights...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And yet... Perhaps I still lacked
the necessary resolve.
choice_data_list: I admire Chrono's spirit! Go for it!
You weren't wrong to decide it was time to call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're really putting in the effort, aren't you?♪
Did Chrono-chan get inspired by Ai-san and Lala-san too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan...
When you say 'too', does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, us too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, let's train together.
A blazing hundred-mile heat that won't lose to those two!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan... yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After sweating it out and pushing each other to the limit,
Chrono Genesis looked like she had grown somehow.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However... if I wish to leave my name in history,
I must handle a volume of work that rivals the two of you—
choice_data_list: Because you have your own pace to follow.
You have your own pace to keep

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That is... true, but...
choice_data_list: In the long run, I think taking a break is the smarter move.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In the long run...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It is undeniable that I am fatigued.
In order to weave history for even longer...
I should step back for now, without overexerting myself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...That will be all for training.
Get plenty of rest... and we'll be sure to see results."
